Market today: The mood in tech and chips is shaky. Nvidia's CEO resignation and warnings of further selloffs are the real drivers, creating uncertainty across your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SOXL is down a brutal -70.79%, and MUU is down -51.47%. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning these drops are amplified, especially on margin. SMCI is also down -36.69%. These need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Nvidia's price action and how the broader chip sector reacts to the CEO news. Any further weakness there will hit your book hard.

Bottom line: Your heavy concentration in leveraged tech/chips, combined with margin, means managing risk on your deep red positions is paramount right now.
plays: Respect stops on leveraged ETFs: QQQI at 52, PLTU at 49, and SMH at 540. These are close and need to be honored to prevent further deep losses.
Consider trimming CRWD (31.02% gain) to lock in profits and reduce overall portfolio risk, especially with tech uncertainty.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market signals are too mixed for new long positions in your core sectors.
